main.summary: Builds integrity evidence for a requested prefix from persisted source segment hashes.
main.remarks: Complete source segments retain their persisted hashes. When a prefix ends partway through a source segment, the partial segment is re-read and hashed while the entire source segment is verified against its persisted digest. The resulting prefix segments are passed to the domain-separated integrity calculator.

method.name: BuildAsync
method.summary: Builds an integrity summary and canonical segments covering the requested prefix.
method.param: Persisted source segment evidence; segments must provide contiguous coverage from offset zero.
Length of the prefix to cover.
Callback used to hash a source segment when the requested prefix ends inside it.
method.returns: A tuple containing the computed integrity summary and prefix segments, or null when the evidence is malformed, incomplete, or cannot provide a required partial-segment hash.

method.name: HashPartialSegmentAsync
method.summary: Hashes a prefix of a source segment and verifies the full source segment against its persisted SHA-512 digest.
method.param: Persisted source segment, including its offset, full length, and SHA-512 digest.
Number of leading bytes in the segment to hash for the returned prefix digest.
Callback that opens the full source segment range.
Cancellation token for opening and reading the source segment.
method.returns: The SHA-512 digest of the requested leading bytes.
method.exception: The source segment or requested partial length is invalid.
The source segment cannot be opened.
The opened source segment ends before its declared length.
The full segment bytes do not match the persisted SHA-512 digest.
